title: The Maharashtra Water Resources Regulatory Authority Act, 2005
full_text: The Maharashtra Water Resources Regulatory Authority Act, 2005 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200518 Act Number: 18 Enactment Date: 2005-05-04 Act Year: 2005 Short Title: The Maharashtra Water Resources Regulatory Authority Act, 2005 Long Title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Maharashtra Water Resources Regulatory Authority to regulate water resources within the State of Maharashtra, facilitate and ensure judicious, equitable and sustainable management, allocation and utilisation of water resources, fix the rates for use of water for agriculture, industrial, drinking and other purposes, and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
